notes: Payload offsets remain base-zero in analysis, but AUIPC absolute addresses must use the linked code base 0x8000.
The boot updater programs this image at flash alias 0x08008000; the statically accepted slot is 0x18000 bytes (96 KiB).
Startup transfers to a resident BLE library at 0x00040000; its jump table begins at 0x00040034. Its backing storage is not present in the downloaded image.
gp-relative addressing (gp=0x20004000) is used for the BLE state block, including the 256-byte shortcut table at gp+0x80.
